cells.gaps: GAB-002 says Gabon lands 2Africa among four cable systems, but no source states that 2Africa, or another cable of more than 100 Tbps design capacity, is in service carrying Gabon's traffic. No source found says other operators buy capacity on the routes.
cells.note: SPIN's director-general (GAB-006, October 2026) places the ACE landing beside backbone links to Cameroon, Equatorial Guinea and Congo, a cable and a land link through a neighbour, so two independent routes. TM Africa's statement that Gabon lands 2Africa (GAB-002) does not say the cable is in service, so question 3a is not read as met and the stage stays 3.
